snippet.title: QUOD INIT EXIT IIo / trailer
snippet.description:
QUOD INIT EXIT IIo is an unconventional platformer for Commodore 64 characterized by original mechanics, non-linear environments, puzzles, lightning fast scrolling, colorful hires graphics, special effects and porkessive music.

https://www.retream.com/QUOD_INIT_EXIT_IIo
